Package com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap

package com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap
  • Class
    Description
    Dn
    A Distinguished Name (DN): an ordered, most-specific-first sequence of Rdn components (RFC 4514).
    LdapEntry
    A directory entry: a distinguished name plus an ordered multimap of attribute name → values.
    LdapFilter
    Typed, immutable model of an RFC 4515 LDAP search filter.
    LdapFilter.And
    Conjunction (&(...)(...)) — matches when every child matches (RFC 4515 §2).
    LdapFilter.Approx
    Approximate match (attr~=value) (RFC 4515 §2, filtertype ~=).
    LdapFilter.Equality
    Equality match (attr=value) (RFC 4515 §2, "simple" with filtertype =).
    LdapFilter.ExtensibleMatch
    Extensible match (attr:dn:rule:=value) (RFC 4515 §2, extensible).
    LdapFilter.GreaterOrEqual
    Ordering match (attr>=value) (RFC 4515 §2, filtertype >=).
    LdapFilter.LessOrEqual
    Ordering match (attr<=value) (RFC 4515 §2, filtertype <=).
    LdapFilter.Not
    Negation (!(...)) — matches when the single child does not (RFC 4515 §2).
    LdapFilter.Or
    Disjunction (|(...)(...)) — matches when any child matches (RFC 4515 §2).
    LdapFilter.Present
    Presence test (attr=*) — the attribute has at least one value (RFC 4515 §2).
    LdapFilter.Substring
    Substring match (attr=ini*any*fin) (RFC 4515 §2).
    LdapFilterBuilder
    Pure, offline composer of RFC 4515 search filters from simple (attribute, operator, value) rows.
    LdapFilterBuilder.Condition
    One filter row: an attribute matched against value using operator.
    LdapFilterBuilder.Operator
    How an attribute is matched against a value when rendering a LdapFilterBuilder.Condition.
    LdapFilterParser
    Pure, offline, dependency-free parser for RFC 4515 LDAP search filters.
    LdapFilterParser.LdapFilterParseException
    Thrown when a filter string is not valid per RFC 4515.
    LdapService
    LDAP / Active Directory client over the UnboundID LDAP SDK.
    LdapService.ApplyResult
    Whether LdapService.applyEntry(java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.util.List<java.lang.String>>) created a new entry or updated an existing one.
    LdapService.Entry
    A directory entry: its DN plus attributes decoded to string lists (binary values summarised).
    LdapService.Mod
    A single attribute change applied by LdapService.modifyEntry(java.lang.String, java.util.List<com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap.LdapService.Mod>).
    LdapService.ModType
    Which way a LdapService.Mod changes an attribute on an existing entry.
    LdapUrl
    A parsed LDAP URL (RFC 4516): ldap[s]://[host[:port]]/[dn][?attributes[?scope[?filter[?extensions]]]].
    LdapUrl.Extension
    One URL extension (RFC 4516 §2): an optional !-critical marker, a type, and an optional value.
    LdapUrl.LdapUrlException
    Thrown when an LDAP URL (or one of its components) is malformed.
    LdapUrl.Scope
    Search scope carried in the third query section of an LDAP URL (RFC 4516 §2).
    LdifReader
    Parses RFC 2849 LDIF text into LdapEntry records.
    LdifWriter
    Serializes LdapEntry records to RFC 2849 LDIF text.
    Rdn
    A single Relative Distinguished Name (RDN) — one or more type=value attribute-value assertions joined by '+' (multi-valued RDN).
    Rdn.Ava
    One type=value assertion within an RDN.

NexusLink — one console, every protocol, zero context switching.
